sql_reading_A.sql:
WITH dept_courses AS (
    SELECT
        s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS department_code,
        s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
        s.COURSE_NUMBER,
        s.SUBJECT_ID,
        s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
        s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
    FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED s
    WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%'
      AND s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE IN ('18', '5')
),
dept_stats AS (
    SELECT
        department_code,
        MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment
    FROM dept_courses
    GROUP BY department_code
)
SELECT
    d.department_name,
    d.max_enrollment,
    ...
    AVG(c.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment
FROM dept_stats d
JOIN dept_courses c
  ON c.department_code = d.department_code
WHERE d.max_enrollment > 5
GROUP BY d.department_name, d.max_enrollment;

question_text: For each department, what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any course offered by that department in 2019, what is the name of the responsible faculty member for that course, and what is the average number of enrolled students for all such courses in that department, considering only courses where the maximum number of enrolled students is greater than 5, and only including departments of Mathematics (Course 18) and Chemistry (Course 5)? Do not return any rounded answers.
